construction_notes.text: From the state Housing Element Annual Progress Report, through 2025.

City of San Jose permit SP20-020 (Special Use Permit/Amendment, folder year 2020), status Approved, issue date 2020-07-08: "***FILE CONVERTED FROM H18-025*** Site Development Permit to allow demolition of an existing building and construct a new 21 story building with approximately 123,479 square foot office space, 290 residential units, and approximately 7,603 square feet" (city text cut off at 255 characters)
Steinberg Hart page: client Acquity Realty Inc.; 19 stories, about 75,000 sq ft office, enclosed parking, rooftop pool, lounge and fitness; lists both 290 and 220 residential units.
Bisnow (2019-08-14): Acquity was seeking entitlements for a 21-story mixed-use tower at Carlysle Street and Notre Dame Avenue, with NorthMarq leading its capitalization.

San Jose Highrises: revised plan for a mid-rise mixed-use building with about half the original units and 4,700 sq ft of ground-floor retail; site listed for sale at $12.5 million; a loan default notice was rescinded.
SiliconValley.com via Kidder Mathews (2025-09-30): the owner avoided foreclosure on the site for a second time and began seeking a buyer.
State report 2020 Table A row for SP20-020 lists 290 owner units proposed and approved; Table A2 2020 lists APNs 259-35-033, -026, -027, -032 and 220 renter units entitled 2020-07-08.
